crossRefs.note: “Get away from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment!” They fell on their faces.
Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.
Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and fell on their faces.…
Joshua tore his clothes, and fell to the earth on his face before Yahweh’s ark until the evening, he and the elders of…
